description:
Ron Hubbard has built underground bunkers for Mark Zuckerberg, Kim Kardashian and the ￼Tate Brothers. After hearing he builds the best bunkers on planet Earth, I was curious. I wanted to know more

I got to meet Ron then we walked through his entire factory while he explained the logic and reason that goes into his bunker builds.

This was an eye opening experience & I gleaned a ton of ideas to take with me back to Costa Rica 🧠
